method: Six original, unmodified PNGs opened using view_image at their screenshot dimensions; no montage or visual reconstruction.

inspected.observation: Shared Cradle crown report is visibly selected in the full-width optional conversation with four crew topics plus a separate Hunt disclosure.
The private workshop scenario exposes the four field reports and their context, with no Cradle option disclosed.
The selected public Cradle report and privacy note remain readable in the narrow scroll card above the footer.
The complete selected Cradle line is visible above the footer after a real wheel gesture. The lower privacy note remains outside this crop and can be reached through further scrolling.
The private scenario shows the selected field line and source note inside the narrow scroll viewport, with no Cradle report.
The retreat outcome supplies a return line without inventing a returned crown, while public disclosure context remains visible.

limits: Only these six of23 original captures were visually inspected.
The strict runtime framing check covers the complete selected report line, not every surrounding heading, option or privacy note simultaneously.
320px wheel input is actual Chromium scrolling, not a physical touchscreen swipe.
Art fidelity, native devices, controller behavior, frame rate and full campaign are not certified.
